pr_title: Add context menu option for duplicating multi rooms
pr_body:
Implements and closes #9589

- [x] Depends on ppy/osu-framework#3805 for tests to pass reliably 

Allows duplicating a multi room by right clicking the room in the lounge

Might need an alternative to the current approach of passing actions around
